guitar.evidence: Gregory Alan Isakov is a folk singer-songwriter typically performing on a steel-string acoustic (commonly reported as Martin), but no singularly iconic documented model.

tone.target: gentle acoustic-folk fingerpicked guitar with dry room
tone.profile: gentle acoustic-folk fingerpicked guitar with dry room
tone.summary: The rig simulates a gentle acoustic-folk sound by prioritizing clean headroom (US Deluxe/Silver Twin), minimal compression, and adding subtle space with Room reverb. The overall tone is warm and dry, suitable for fingerpicked arpeggios.

rig.name: Gregory Alan Isakov - Big Black Car - Valeton GP-180

blocks.gap: While compression is useful, it must be subtle to maintain an intimate feel. The Comp module handles this well.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a small, intimate acoustic-electric setup.
